spark_open.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal animal shown in side profile facing right. It has the head, fur, and paws of a brown bear combined with a heavy, glossy, segmented exoskeleton that covers the back, sides, neck, and outer surfaces of all four legs. The exoskeleton is dark brown and shiny on top with overlapping plates, and lighter tan underneath on the belly and chest. A single long, glossy black, curved horn projects from the center of the forehead. The animal stands on four thick legs ending in clawed paws, and has a short, narrow, segmented tail at the rear. The overall appearance is a bear-like mammal encased in woodlouse or isopod-like armor.

spark_open.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background. It has the overall body shape, dense brown fur, head shape, and clawed paws of a bear, but most of its dorsal surface, neck, sides, and outer limbs are covered in glossy, dark brown to black overlapping segmented armor plates that resemble the exoskeleton of an isopod or pill bug. The armor forms a continuous carapace over the back from the neck to the rear, with separate plated sections over the shoulders, hips, and limbs, and lighter tan segmented plating visible on the underside and inner legs. A single large, curved, glossy black horn with small tooth-like notches along its inner edge projects from a helmet-like plate on top of the head. The animal stands on four thick legs with broad paws, and has a short, tapered, segmented tail at the rear.

meta_spark.description: A large four-legged creature shown in side view facing right, with the overall shape, head, dense brown fur, and clawed paws of a brown bear, but covered over most of its body with glossy dark brown segmented armor. The bear-like head has a tan muzzle, black nose, brown eyes, and small rounded furry ears. A single long slender glossy black horn with a small barb curves upward from the top of the head. The dark armor forms overlapping plates over the top of the head, neck, back, sides, shoulders, hips, and legs, with lighter tan segmented plating visible on the underside and chest. The legs are thick and end in broad furry bear paws with long claws. A small narrow tapered segmented armored tail hangs at the rear.
